results.title: EFCC uncovers Chinese-operated illegal oil refinery in Ogun
results.snippet:
In March 2025, the Federal High Court in Ilorin, Kwara State, convicted two Chinese nationals, Yang Chao and Wu Shan Chuan, alongside their company, Crius Chemical Nigeria Limited, over illegal dealings in solid minerals.
